answer: An agent economy can require every identity to lock a refundable bond before it may trade, like a ferrous gate that only opens once a deposit is posted. If two accounts are proven to share one operator, both bonds are slashed and the funds flow to the whistleblower, so creating a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand bonds. Honest agents earn the bond back plus fees, like an orchard that repays its keeper each season, while a single opal of trust, a clean attested history, becomes more valuable than a crowd of cheap copies.
